policy.interpretation: retrospective development diagnostic; not a newly selected model or holdout result
policy.scoring: same first-available outcomes and development dates as the saved models
policy.selection: all three constants fixed independently of observed outcomes; no best-class selection

inventory_feature_summary.information_cutoff: release date strictly before each historical forecast; earliest eligible issuance no later than forecast

protocol.boundary_rule: forecast and target dates must both precede holdout start
protocol.candidate_selection: retrospective single predefined C=0.1 candidate after observing earlier development results
protocol.fit_schedule: expand and refit at every development forecast
protocol.forecast_cohort: exact forecast IDs, dates, targets and scoring states from the verified WTI reference
protocol.holdout_status: closed: no fitting, prediction, scoring or tuning
protocol.inventory_cutoff: release date strictly before each historical forecast; freeze features at that issuance
protocol.inventory_four_week_change: current stock minus latest available exact observation 28 days earlier; same definition regime
protocol.inventory_missing: retain nulls and explicit reasons; fit median imputation only on training rows; no missing-indicator inputs
protocol.inventory_report_age: calendar days since actual latest eligible release; shared between both series
protocol.inventory_sources: audited EIA commercial-crude and Cushing issue archives; qualified archive replay

logistic.imputer: training median; all-missing training column uses zero
training median; all-missing training column uses zero

logistic_wti_inventory.imputer: training median; all-missing training column uses zero

logistic_wti_inventory_c01.imputer: training median; all-missing training column uses zero

protocol.primary_comparison: paired development Brier score and log loss for C=0.1 minus C=1 inventory; accuracy and yearly stability also reported
protocol.reference_reproduction: require exact selected authenticated WTI and C=1 inventory cohorts, training, inventory provenance and model payloads; native runtime fingerprints must match before fitting
protocol.scoring_labels: first jointly available pair, available before holdout start
protocol.success_criteria: report aggregate Brier/log-loss differences against C=1 and both simple probability benchmarks; report each yearly difference descriptively, without a formal success threshold or significance claim
protocol.training_cohort: exact original WTI-eligible rows and active labels; missing inventory never removes rows
protocol.training_labels: active as of issuance under the preceding-calendar-day convention
protocol.tuning: one fixed regularization candidate; no grid, feature, threshold, date or holdout changes
protocol.uncertainty: descriptive yearly results; no independent-sample significance claim
protocol.unusable_inventory_issue: all four changes null; known release metadata still supplies report age; no older-issue or PDF fallback
